parameters.help_en: The column encryption status filter. Valid values: NotEncrypted: not encrypted. Success: encrypted. Failed: encryption failed
parameters.help_zh: 列加密状态筛选。NotEncrypted：未加密；Success：加密成功；Failed：加密失败
parameters.name: masking_status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data classification template. You can obtain the ID from the Items[].Id parameter in the response of the ListTemplates operation. The ID must be consistent with the selected sensitivity level and identification model
parameters.help_zh: 分类分级模板标识，可从 ListTemplates 的 Items[].Id 获取；与所选敏感等级和识别模型保持一致
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the sensitivity level. You can obtain the ID from the response of the ListRiskLevels operation
parameters.help_zh: 敏感等级标识，可从 ListRiskLevels 的返回列表获取
parameters.name: risk_level_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud service type. Valid values: 5: RDS. 8: POLARDB. 27: PolarDBX2. If you specify this parameter and ProductCode at the same time, the values must match
parameters.help_zh: 云产品类型标识。5：RDS；8：POLARDB；27：PolarDBX2。与 ProductCode 同时指定时应对应
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en: The code of the cloud service. Column encryption supports RDS, POLARDB, and PolarDBX2. If you specify this parameter and ProductId at the same time, the values must match
parameters.help_zh: 云产品编码。列加密支持 RDS、POLARDB、PolarDBX2；如同时传入 ProductId，二者必须对应
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The database instance identity. You can obtain the identity from the Items[].InstanceId parameter in the response of the ListDataMaskingInstances operation
parameters.help_zh: 数据库实例标识，可从 ListDataMaskingInstances 的 Items[].InstanceId 获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the database engine. The value must be consistent with the EngineType of the target instance, such as MySQL or PostgreSQL
parameters.help_zh: 数据库引擎类型，应与目标实例的 EngineType 一致，例如 MySQL 或 PostgreSQL
parameters.name: engine_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the model tag. This parameter is used to filter data that matches the specified model tag
parameters.help_zh: 模型标签标识，用于限定命中对应模型标签的数据
parameters.name: model_tag_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the table. In PostgreSQL or Oracle scenarios, retain the schema.table format obtained from the table list
parameters.help_zh: 数据表名称。PostgreSQL 或 Oracle 场景应保留从表列表取得的 schema.table 形式
parameters.name: table_name

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current query. Pages start from 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前查询页码，从 1 开始
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Keep other filter conditions consistent when querying the next page
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的记录数。查询下一页时保持其他筛选条件一致
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The list of sensitivity level IDs. Separate multiple values with commas (,). Select the values from the response of the ListRiskLevels operation that corresponds to the same TemplateId
parameters.help_zh: 敏感等级标识列表，多个值用英文逗号分隔；从同一 TemplateId 对应的 ListRiskLevels 返回值中选择
parameters.name: risk_level_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of identification model IDs. Separate multiple values with commas (,). Select the values from the response of the ListIdentifyModels operation that corresponds to the same TemplateId
parameters.help_zh: 识别模型标识列表，多个值用英文逗号分隔；从同一 TemplateId 对应的 ListIdentifyModels 返回值中选择
parameters.name: template_rule_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of cloud service type IDs. Separate multiple values with commas (,). In column encryption scenarios, the valid values are 5 (RDS), 8 (POLARDB), and 27 (PolarDBX2)
parameters.help_zh: 云产品类型标识列表，多个值用英文逗号分隔。列加密场景对应 5（RDS）、8（POLARDB）、27（PolarDBX2）
parameters.name: product_ids

parameters.help_en: The filter condition for the column name
parameters.name: column_name

parameters.help_en: The language of the response description. Valid values: zh: Chinese. en: English
parameters.help_zh: 响应说明的语言。zh：中文；en：英文
parameters.name: lang

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the returned data

Items.description_en: The list of records returned by the current query
Items.description_zh: 本次查询返回的记录列表

EncryptionAlgorithm.description_en: The current column encryption algorithm of the instance
EncryptionAlgorithm.description_zh: 实例当前的列加密算法

EncryptionKeyId.description_en: The ID of the KMS key used by the instance. This parameter may not be returned in local key scenarios
EncryptionKeyId.description_zh: 实例使用的 KMS 密钥标识；本地密钥场景可不返回

EngineType.description_en: The type of the database engine

FullAccessAccountCount.description_en: The number of database accounts that have the fullAccess plaintext access permissions
FullAccessAccountCount.description_zh: 拥有 fullAccess 明文访问权限的数据库账号数量

ProductCode.description_en: The code of the cloud service

ProductId.description_en: The ID of the cloud service type. Valid values: 5: RDS. 8: POLARDB. 27: PolarDBX2

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the asset is located

RegionName.description_en: The name of the region where the asset is located

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page in the current query
PageSize.description_zh: 本次查询的每页记录数

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which can be used to locate the current API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，可用于定位本次 API 调用

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries that meet the current statistics or query scope
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合当前统计或查询范围的总数量
